column1: # config/SLUS-20836/units.tsv — one build profile per translation unit (docs/engine/build-profiles.md).
# Maintained, not regenerated: tools/gen_unit_profiles.py drew the first version from sweeps that are not in
# the repository. tools/roll_profile.py moves whole units; to add or change a unit by hand follow
# docs/engine/build-profiles.md and keep the columns below.
#   lo <= function start < hi; flags is the complete flag string except the exception mode;
#   exceptions on|off (off adds -Cpp_exceptions off to an MWCC compile); status - or provisional
#   (the members' evidence has no common profile: the majority profile is recorded and the
#   dissenting members keep a provisional row in unit-flags.tsv / unit-compilers.tsv).
